notes.title: Forgotten Sound: The Complete Journey bundle is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
If you have either one of the Forgotten Sound games in your library, now you can complete the set and get 30% off the regular price!

About the games in this bundle:

Forgotten Sound 1: Revelation

“Music is the melody of life”. Prince Shahbaz remembers hearing this sentence constantly from his mother. Following her death, Shahrdad Shah, his father, had forbidden playing all instruments as he couldn’t bear the memory of his beloved wife that accompanied the music. Nevertheless, the vizier’s trickery to send the King to a magical sleep worked and Prince Shahbaz was convicted of treason for playing the instrument for his father. The vizier also broke the strings of the mother’s instrument. With the help of his wife, Shahbaz manages to escape from prison and goes on a journey to find and mend the strings, save his father, and remove the stain of treason. But journeys are not always easy…

Forgotten Sound 2: Destiny

Continuing his mystery-riddled journey, Shahbaz has to cross over lands that he could not have even imagined in his dreams to fix the mother’s instrument and save his father from the treacherous vizier; from the blazing Land of Lava to the cursed Land of Water, from the land whose colors have worn off to the land of molten marbles and the land of wild monkeys. It’s a journey whose end is much more astonishing than what Shahbaz has ever experienced…

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5939/

notes.title: Forgotten Sound 2: Destiny is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Continue the fantastic journey of Prince Shahbaz as he tries to save his father and his homeland from the treacherous Vizier. This is the second and final installment of the series which began with Forgotten Sound 1: Revelation.

About this game:

Continuing his mystery-riddled journey, Shahbaz has to cross over lands that he could not have even imagined in his dreams to fix the mother’s instrument and save his father from the treacherous vizier; from the blazing Land of Lava to the cursed Land of Water, from the land whose colors have worn off to the land of molten marbles and the land of wild monkeys. It’s a journey whose end is much more astonishing than what Shahbaz has ever experienced…


Game features

1. A mysterious romantic story adapted from the book of the One Thousand and One Nights
2. More than 10 mini games, classic environmental puzzles, etc.
3. Beautiful, eye-catching 2D graphics inspired by Gothic, Roman, and Persian architecture
4. 10 mysterious characters, each with their own unique land 
5. More than 30 minutes of delightful classical music
6. More than 30 minutes of motion comic for a more precise narration of the story
7. More than 4 hours of gameplay

http://store.steampowered.com/app/783960/Forgotten_Sound_2_Destiny/
